description: Let Ab_k be the set of abelian groups of order k, M_k the set of rings Z/mZ such that phi(m) = k, and let f_k : M_k -> Ab_k be the map such that f_k(Z/mZ) = (Z/mZ)*, the group of units of Z/mZ. a(n) is the least r such that f_k is injective for k = p*2^r, p the n-th prime. a(n) = -1 if no such number exists.
